name: acumen
description: Acumen: the daily case file. Four original daily games rolled into one Acumen Score.

scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync ios
scripts.cap:run: npm run build && npx cap sync ios && npx cap open ios
scripts.build:rank: babel --config-file ./rank/src/babel.config.json rank/src/app.jsx -o rank/app.js && tailwindcss -c rank/src/tailwind.config.js -i rank/src/tailwind.css -o rank/rank.css --minify

author: Joel Comm
